rules.title: How to play
rules.goal: Hang one lantern in each district.
rules.lines: One lantern per row and per column.
rules.touch: Two lanterns never touch, not even diagonally.
rules.click: Click: lantern, then cross, then empty. Right click: cross.
win.title: Bravo!
garden.rules.goal: Plant one carrot in each plot.
garden.rules.lines: One carrot per row and per column, so each one gets all its light.
garden.rules.touch: Two carrots never touch, not even diagonally: they would share the soil's energy.
garden.rules.click: Click: carrot, then cross, then empty. Right click: cross.
flowers.rules.goal: Plant one sprout in each plot.
flowers.rules.lines: One sprout per row and per column.
flowers.rules.touch: Two sprouts never touch, not even diagonally.
flowers.rules.click: Click: sprout, then cross, then empty. Right click: cross.
flowers.win.text: The whole garden is in bloom!
fox.rules.goal: Settle one fox in each territory.
fox.rules.lines: One fox per row and per column.
fox.rules.touch: Two foxes never touch, not even diagonally.
fox.rules.click: Click: fox, then cross, then empty. Right click: cross.
fox.win.text: Every fox is happy in its den!
